extras: Desktop only; requires a local file-sync service (Dropbox, Syncthing, etc.) to manage the sync folder.
problem: Users cannot easily resume long, complex AI agent conversations started on one computer on another machine.

relations.evidence: This is an independent companion plugin for users of the Claudian plugin (YishenTu/claudian).

summary: Sync raw session files of Claudian-supported agent CLIs across machines to allow conversation resumption.
